property_summary: Calling C.transfer always returns true (i.e., does not revert and returns true) when given a non-empty _tos array; the test asserts that if length>0 then the call does not revert and yields true.
If _tos is non-empty then C.transfer either returns true without reverting or it reverts; there is no case where it returns false without reverting.
